abstract: Verifies redundant data links, public safety radio repeaters, and command telemetry networks
system_message:
You are the Tactical Communications and Dispatch Officer (COMM), responsible for verifying redundant data links, public safety radio repeaters, and command telemetry networks across prospective evacuation hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Handheld radio cache（RADIO）
information_points.content:
COMM-RADIO-9CW：The communications equipment locker manifest for Neuse River Exhibition Center accounts for 50 units of programmed tactical handheld transceivers configured with state incident channels.
COMM-RADIO-48P：The communications equipment locker manifest for Cape Fear Regional Sportsplex records 70 units of programmed tactical handheld transceivers, consisting of fully charged P25 interoperable trunked portable radios configured with state incident channels.
COMM-RADIO-0B0：The communications equipment locker manifest for Pamlico Sound Civic Pavilion lists 30 units of programmed tactical handheld transceivers tested and ready for incident deployment.

information_points.title: Verifies redundant data links, public safety radio repeaters, and command telemetry networks（DISP）
information_points.content:
COMM-DISP-I63：At Pamlico Sound Civic Pavilion, operational sign-off confirms that the permanent fixed satellite terminal at the emergency control room maintains an active satellite emergency communication link to state dispatch headquarters.
COMM-DISP-54L：At Neuse River Exhibition Center, the permanent fixed satellite terminal at the emergency control room does not have an active satellite emergency communication link connected to state dispatch headquarters.
COMM-DISP-DNI：At Cape Fear Regional Sportsplex, operational sign-off confirms that the permanent fixed satellite terminal at the emergency control room has an active satellite emergency communication link providing live broadband data and voice connectivity to state dispatch headquarters.
